== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Snowtrooper (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|Snowtrooper]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100677 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100677], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100677-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>764260cee2e1faeb92402e3dde1eb5bfc33b663f3962b584a5cdff95bb020a56</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
